{{Top|leg}}
'''Bartyn's Retreat''' was a small island in the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], [[Guther Bartyn]] had a mansion there to which he sometimes sent cargoes of food.

{{Nature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the bad ending of the adventure ''[[Reckonings]]'', the angry, native [[Menahuun]] raid Bartyn's Retreat, burn up the house and take over the island &mdash; something that the player characters would only discover when reaching the place with a cargo of food.
